美国国务院 J-1 交流访问者项目下的营地辅导员类别：在美夏令营担任辅导员，直接: The camp counselor category of the U.S. Department of State's J-1 Exchange Visitor Program: working at an American summer camp as a counselor, with direct responsibility for supervising a group of American youth and organising their activities, for up to four months. It is a J-1 like Summer Work Travel, but eligibility does not hinge on student status -- enrolled students, youth workers, teachers and people with specialised skills all qualify -- which makes it one of the few J-1 categories open to young people who are already working. You must go through a State Department-designated sponsor and the placement must be arranged in advance.
22 CFR 62.30 未对国籍设限，只要求是「foreign nationa: 22 CFR 62.30 sets no nationality restriction beyond being a "foreign national". A mainland Chinese passport holder can apply only if a designated sponsor will take them and a camp placement can be arranged -- whether the official sponsor list contains a mainland China channel could not be verified in this round (see source 4).
法规原文只有下限：Are at least 18 years of age（22: The regulation gives only a floor: "Are at least 18 years of age" (22 CFR 62.30(b)(1)). There is no upper limit anywhere in the text, so it is open-ended above 18. This is a confirmed absence of a cap, not an unverified value.
无学历层级要求，但身份须属于四类之一：Are bona fide youth w: No qualification level is required, but you must fall into one of four categories: "Are bona fide youth workers, students, teachers, or individuals with specialized skills" (22 CFR 62.30(b)(2)). Someone already working can apply as a youth worker or under specialised skills, but in practice each sponsor decides whether that holds -- interpretations may differ between organisations, so this remains unverified.
须 Sufficiently proficient in the English: You must be "Sufficiently proficient in the English language to supervise and interact with American youth" (official program page). No IELTS or TOEFL cut-off is published; sponsors assess it at interview, so no test or score is listed here.
22 CFR 62.30 未设资金门槛。但须自付项目费、机票与前期食宿，且项目费: 22 CFR 62.30 sets no funds threshold. You still pay the program fee, airfare and initial living costs yourself; the fee amount is not published and is set by each sponsor (not verified). Pay must, by regulation, match what American counselors in the same role receive.
强制。22 CFR 62.14 规定最低额度：医疗每事故/疾病不低于 $100,: Required. 22 CFR 62.14 sets the minimums: medical benefits of at least $100,000 per accident or illness, repatriation of remains $25,000, medical evacuation $50,000, and deductibles no higher than $500. Usually bundled into the sponsor's program fee.
官方未设年度名额上限。但对重复参与者有比例限制：参加过两次以上的人不得超过该 S: No annual cap is set. There is a ratio limit on repeat participants, though: people who have taken part more than twice may not exceed 10% of the total the sponsor placed in the preceding year (22 CFR 62.30(j)). The placement must also be arranged in advance -- a sponsor may not bring in anyone whose camp placement is not yet secured (62.30(h)(3)).

The program must run during the long break between academic years, for no more than four months, and cannot be extended (62.30(h)(2); the resource page states "Extensions of program participation are not permitted").

The SEVIS I-901 fee is $35 and must be paid before the interview (ICE fee table: "Camp counselor program $35"). The visa fee (MRV) could not be confirmed this round: travel.state.gov returned 403 on all three routes tried, so it is recorded as unverified rather than borrowed from other J-1 categories.

不可延期（22 CFR 62.30(h)(2) 限定项目不超过 4 个月；官方资: Cannot be extended (22 CFR 62.30(h)(2) caps the program at four months; the resource page states "Extensions of program participation are not permitted"). You can however take part again: the regulation only caps people who have participated more than twice at 10% of the sponsor's prior-year total (62.30(j)) and does not forbid repeat participation. So "this one cannot be lengthened" and "you can come back another year" are both true.

法规原文说明这些岗位不属于本项目范围：this program is not i: The regulation states that these roles are outside the program: "this program is not intended to assist American camps in bringing in foreign nationals to serve as administrative personnel, cooks, or menial laborers" (22 CFR 62.30(a)). Participants must have direct responsibility for supervising a group of American youth; non-counseling chores are part of camp life but you may not be brought in as "staff". Pay must match that of American counselors in the same role.

「不看学籍」不等于「谁都能申」。法规限定四类身份，在职人士须被 Sponsor: "Not tied to student status" does not mean "open to anyone". The regulation limits participation to four categories, and someone already working has to be accepted by the sponsor as a youth worker or under specialised skills; interpretations vary between organisations. If sponsors do not accept them, the program is effectively closed to office workers with no youth-work background -- this is the biggest unverified point in the record.
官方 Sponsor 名单是 serverSide 分页表格，翻页端点稳定返回: The official sponsor list is a server-side paginated table whose paging endpoint returns HTTP 400 consistently, so this round only retrieved the first 100 rows, of which one is in the Camp Counselor category (ESF Dream Camp, PA). None of the large J-1 sponsors -- CIEE, InterExchange and others -- appear in those 100 rows, which confirms it is only page one. Whether mainland China has a designated sponsor or partner channel could not be verified; if it does not, the "can apply" conclusion does not hold.

优势：18 岁以上无上限，是在职青年少数可申的 J-1 类别；SEVIS 费仅: Upside: no upper age limit above 18, making it one of the few J-1 categories open to young professionals; the SEVIS fee is only $35 (against $220 for J-1 generally and $350 for F-1); pay must match American counselors; and it shares the J-1 and sponsor system with the Summer Work Travel record already in this dataset, so the research cost is low.
